method.gate: bounded poll of Win32 WS_EX_TRANSPARENT (0x20) on the overlay HWND + GetForegroundWindow == expected HWND (target for ON, overlay for OFF), then SendInput in the same PowerShell process
method.electronAuthority: main-process tracked ignoreMouse value + HWNDs via IPC (uses the Electron getter when the runtime exposes one)
method.foreground: AttachThreadInput + SetForegroundWindow (forceForeground) before the bounded gate
method.counters: bounded poll for the counter delta, no fixed post-click sleep
